info.name: ADSB Exchange Geopolitical Filtering Traces API

params.name: jsonFile
params.description: Name of the JSON file. Must be in the format 'trace_[recent|full]_{ICAO}.json'.

items.docs:
Returns the trace file for the aircraft with the specified ICAO code.

The trace file contains aircraft position history starting 00:00 UTC today.
Must begin with 'trace_recent_' or 'trace_full_' and end with '.json'.
Folder name must be the last 2 characters of the aircraft ICAO code.

Example: to request trace file for aircraft with ICAO code 'A1B2C3':
```
GET /api/aircraft/v2/traces/c3/trace_recent_a1b2c3.json
```

items.docs:
Returns the trace file for the aircraft with the specified ICAO code.

The trace file contains aircraft position history before UTC today.
For getting the trace file for the current day, use the 'Get recent trace file' endpoint.
File name must begin with 'trace_full_' and end with '.json'.
Folder name must be the last 2 characters of the aircraft ICAO code.
